derived_from: valuation-v3 (only the postcode_delta encoding differs; general model, effects method and conformal method are v3's)
excluded_features: utgangspris (not present in this file; would be leakage if it were)

selection.rule: candidates within 0.1 pp of the best Jan-Jun 5-fold CV MAPE; among them the lowest Jan-Jun postnummer-grouped CV MAPE

conformal_interval_evaluation.method: time+area-aware split conformal on log(price_per_sqm): train Jan-May, calibrate q per area on June (>=30 rows) else pooled June q, coverage on held-out Jul-Aug

production_model.interval: bounds = exp(model_log_pred +/- q_log_for_area) * smearing_factor * living_area; q from conformal_interval_evaluation.q_per_area_log, fallback q_overall_log

production_general_model.formula: r(x) = clip(exp(g(x)) * smearing_factor / normaliser, clip_min, clip_max); g(x) = booster output (log of price per m2 relative to the omrade average)
production_general_model.target: log(price_per_sq_meter / mean price_per_sq_meter of the row's omrade), no location features

production_general_model_nofee.formula: r(x) = clip(exp(g(x)) * smearing_factor / normaliser, clip_min, clip_max); g(x) = booster output (log of price per m2 relative to the omrade average)
production_general_model_nofee.target: log(price_per_sq_meter / mean price_per_sq_meter of the row's omrade), no location features

regional_method_note: copied unchanged from valuation-v3/metadata.json; general_model*.json and general_parity_fixtures.json are byte-identical copies (the general model uses no postnummer)
